prompt: With amr1, carry crate1 from the dock to the table, wait 2 minutes there and carry it back to the dock. Keep repeating that round, but stop everything after 90 seconds.
blockers: one round takes 2 minutes and the whole job may take 90 seconds
why: A duration bound below the time of a single run: the first run alone would pass the bound. A run is never cut (a task run is complete and verified), so nothing can be repeated within 90 seconds.
